text:
maria: Heads-up — profiling after yesterday's scheduler tweak shows a regression. Batch formation latency up ~12% for mid-size prompts (40-200 tokens). Dashboard: https://redwood/perf/dash/xyz. Anyone looked into why the midlen cohort spiked?
kevin: I dug a bit. Traces point to KV prefetch blocking the admission path when merge_window_ms > 8. The batcher waits for prefetch to finish before admitting, so we see extra wall time.
sasha: We also shifted the decode-rate buckets in canary earlier this week, so more requests landed in the "steady-decode" pool. That pool goes down the prefetch-heavy path. Could be the intersection.
maria: Repro notes: repro perf locally by replaying requests with seq_len in [60,140], + enable kv_prefetch in runtime. Kernel fallback count also rose in the same window (more memcpy churn).
kevin: Quick mitigation idea: reduce merge_window_ms to 6 and add prefetch_timeout_ms=3 so we don't stall waiting on slow caches. Also cap token_budget_per_batch for midlen to 1024 to avoid huge gathers.
sasha: Agreed. Also consider admitting without prefetch if timeout triggers (serve partly-cold batch) — better than stalling.
maria: Proposed rollout plan:
- change admission: merge_window_ms: 6, prefetch_timeout_ms: 3
- cohort token_budget targets: short=256, mid=1024, long=2048
- label telemetry by decode_rate_bucket and kv_prefetch_status for 12h
- watch kernel_fallback_count and batcher_admit_wait_ms
Example config snippet:
```
admission:
  merge_window_ms: 6
  prefetch_timeout_ms: 3
cohorts:
  short: { token_budget: 256 }
  mid:   { token_budget: 1024 }
  long:  { token_budget: 2048 }
telemetry:
  labels: [decode_rate_bucket, kv_prefetch_status]
```
kevin: Opening PR now, attaching flamegraphs and a short replay job. I'll canary to 5% and run a 30m synthetic with midlen mix.
perf-bot: perf-check: canary -> baseline p50 +11.8%, p95 +8.0%. KV-prefetch wait correlation with latency = 0.86.
sasha: If prefetch_timeout causes admits without prefetch, note potential quality/cost tradeoffs — add a metric for "partial_warm_batches" so we can evaluate LM quality regressions.
maria: Good call. Also set an alert: if kernel_fallback_count > 5% in canary, rollback immediately.
kevin: Timeline: PR up in 10m, canary tonight, monitor 12h. If stable, ramp to 25% then 100% in 48h.
sasha: I'll own the telemetry dashboards + regression eval prompt set.
maria: :thumbsup: Thanks. If anyone spots other hotspots in flamegraph (memcpy / cublas spikes), ping here and we pause rollout.
kevin: ping @sasha when PR is up.
